finding: Iraqi women showed a high prevalence of overt hypothyroidism, which was associated with caesarean delivery, premature delivery, and high birth weight infants.
mod_finding: 80.32% of women with thyroid hormone deficiency had a caesarean delivery compared to 2.55% of women with normal thyroid function.
gest_age: 39.22 +/- 0.34 weeks in the normal thyroid function group and 36.64 +/- 1.93 weeks in the thyroid hormone deficiency group
birth_weight: High birth weight in infants of mothers with thyroid hormone deficiency
